verdict.rationale: The REST API fully supports the pipeline described — creating verification sessions (stripe-identity-docs-5,13), webhooks/polling for outcomes (stripe-identity-docs-6,15), retrieving extracted data (stripe-identity-docs-4,7,16), and re-checks/manual overrides (stripe-identity-docs-10,11). Stripe also ships an official MCP server for AI agents (stripe-identity-docs-12, stripe-identity-probe-4), but the evidence never confirms the MCP server exposes Identity-specific tools (create session/poll/retrieve/re-check) or documents scoped-credential support for that surface. Missing for 10: MCP tool list showing Identity session lifecycle operations, and explicit scoped-credential/restricted-key guidance for agent use.
